description: WP-S4 Space Wolves reactions in the opponent's Shooting phase. Fixture sw11e_s4_enemy_shoot (P1 Orks ACTIVE, P2 Space Wolves, round 2): Njal Stormcaller leads Grey Hunters; a Wulfen Dreadnought. (1) The Flash Gitz declare their shots at Njal's unit: the defender's reactive StratagemDialog lists STORM CALLER (psychic level 1, cost 'Ability'); a real click makes the psychic roll and gives the unit -3" detection range until the end of the phase (no CP). (2) The Tankbustas shoot the Wulfen Dreadnought (real Fast Roll / Complete Shooting clicks): it lost wounds, so P2's enemy_has_shot window offers BESTIAL RAGE; a real click starts a surge move of up to D6+1" (panel), real Auto-move + Confirm clicks move it toward the Tankbustas. Setup privileges: auto wound allocation, Orks 0 CP, the Dreadnought at 99 W.

steps.script:
SettingsService.set("auto_allocate_wounds", true)
GameState.state.players["1"]["cp"] = 0
for m in GameState.state.units["U_WULFEN_DREADNOUGHT_A"].models:
	m["wounds"] = 99
	m["current_wounds"] = 99
return true
